text:
maria.partnerships: Heads-up: vendor pushed a Gaudi microcode maintenance into APAC week of May 12-16. They asked for a 2h window and marketplace SKU refresh within 48h.

taka.apac-ops: Acknowledge. Any embargo/press?

maria.partnerships: No press embargo, but partner warns ~5% chance of degraded perf on B200 fallback nodes for up to 24h. They want a signed manifest before publish.

kevin.platform: If B200 fallback could degrade we must ensure Dedicated pools don't get routed there. Proposal: runtime route_order apac-gaudi-canary -> apac-gaudi-prod -> fallback-b200, with a latency threshold to trigger fallback.

nisha.eng-infra: Ops plan: canary in apac-coldpool, monitor 6h, 25% ramp, then full. KV cache warming and reduce batch sizes by 10% in canary. Increase telemetry retention for 72h.

sam.se: SI leads (RetailGen, MedRecall) need a 90m dry run 24h prior to deploy for smoke/regression. I'll coordinate time slots (prefer 16:00-17:30 APAC).

maria.partnerships: I'll ask partner to provide signed build list + manifest 48h before. Request rollback window of 48h and signed builds list.

kevin.platform: Quick runtime config example (for ops): {"route_order": ["apac-gaudi-canary","apac-gaudi-prod","fallback-b200"], "fallback_threshold": "2.0x_latency"} -- can push as flag and revert.

nisha.eng-infra: I'll create maintenance entry and incident stub, publish runbook in #eng-runtime, and pre-provision marketplace CI token for manifest ingestion (POST /marketplace/ingest). Example curl will be provided to partner.

taka.apac-ops: Oncall rota proposed: Taka (APAC morning), Keiko (APAC night), Nisha backup. I'll own scheduling.

maria.partnerships: Timeline recap: 48h before: signed manifest; 24h before: 90m dry run + SI smoke tests; Deploy Wed 05/14 03:00 UTC: canary -> 6h monitor -> ramp -> full; 48h post: SKU refresh.

sam.se: Noted. SI leads want the dry run confirmed ASAP.

kevin.platform: If we see >2x p95 regressions, shift traffic to H100/H200 fallback and escalate.

nisha.eng-infra: Preparing fast route-switch scripts and will publish the runbook today.

maria.partnerships: Action items: Maria - partner ask + manifest; Taka - oncall; Nisha - marketplace token + runbook; Sam - SI dry run slots; Kevin - runtime flag & rollback plan. Will sync Mon EOD if partner confirms 05/14. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Maintenance entry created: #gaudi-apac-upgrade, window 2026-05-14T03:00Z, duration 2h. Incident stub INC-1769 created.
